title: PLMN-SEARCH
text: The UE shall perform PLMN selection. If a new PLMN is selected, the UE shall reset the attach attempt counter and initiate the attach or combined attach procedure (see clause 5.5.1)
If the selected cell is known not to be able to provide normal service
- the UE may initiate attach for emergency bearer services; or
- the UE may initiate attach for access to RLOS
